name: epa-drinking-water-mcp-server
description: Search EPA drinking water systems, violations, enforcement actions, and contaminant measurements via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search EPA drinking water systems, violations, enforcement actions, and contaminant measurements via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Read public EPA drinking-water records without an API key: resolve water systems, inspect contact-free inventory and service membership, retrieve historical SDWA violations and enforcement actions, and select Lead and Copper Rule summaries or UCMR 5 occurrence measurements. Responses retain provenance, source uncertainty, and continuation metadata. Optional DuckDB staging in npm or Docker supports read-only SQL over bounded public-data partitions; the Claude Desktop bundle supports the six EPA-reading tools. Quarterly records and limited monitoring participation do not establish current compliance or household tap-water safety.
